topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I opened the door to find a package, the address label prominently displaying a name that wasn't mine. Recognizing it as belonging to the previous tenant, I thought about the best way to handle this. I decided to call the number on the delivery slip, explaining the situation to the sender. They sounded relieved, apologizing for the mix-up and asked if I could hold onto the package until they arranged a pickup. I agreed, it seemed like the simplest solution. I made a note to keep an eye out for the courier, ensuring the package would be safely returned.
